Cambium Networks ePMP Force 300-25
High-Gain 802.11AC Wave 2 Solution - 500+ Mbps Peak Throughput


Cambium Networks ePMP Force 300-25 is a high-performance 5GHz radio solution designed for reliable long-distance connectivity. Featuring an integrated 25dBi dish antenna, this device supports over 500 Mbps throughput, making it ideal for Point-to-Point (PTP) and Point-to-Multipoint (PTMP) applications across rural and urban areas in Bangladesh.

Built on the 802.11ac Wave 2 platform, the Force 300-25 offers advanced features like MU-MIMO, beamforming, and high interference tolerance to ensure stable, high-speed connections even in noisy RF environments. Its rugged outdoor design and easy alignment features make it the go-to solution for ISPs, enterprises, and surveillance networks.

Key Features:

  • Frequency: 5 GHz (licensed/unlicensed)

  • Integrated 25 dBi High-Gain Dish Antenna

  • Throughput: Over 500 Mbps real TCP/IP

  • Protocol: 802.11ac Wave 2

  • Supports TDD mode for scalability

  • Ideal for long-range wireless deployments in Bangladesh

  • IP55-rated weatherproof design

  • Easy installation with alignment tools


Link Distance of Force 300-25:

  • Maximum Link Distance: Up to 30+ kilometers (line-of-sight, clear Fresnel zone, ideal conditions)

  • Typical Stable Distance:

    • Point-to-Point (PTP): 10–25 km

    • Point-to-Multipoint (PTMP Subscriber Module): 5–15 km


Factors Affecting Distance:

  • Line-of-sight (no trees, buildings, or obstructions)

  • Interference level (especially in urban areas)

  • Antenna alignment and elevation

  • Channel width and modulation rate (MCS)

  • Weather conditions (especially rain fade for long links)
